easy.q: In what year did World War I end?
easy.fact: The armistice took effect at 11 a.m. on Nov. 11, now Veterans Day.

easy.q: How many Powerpuff Girls are there?
easy.fact: Blossom, Bubbles and Buttercup were made from sugar, spice and Chemical X.

easy.q: How many countries make up the United Kingdom?
easy.fact: England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.

easy.q: How many rings are on the Olympic flag?
easy.fact: Pierre de Coubertin designed it in 1913.

easy.q: How many members are in the band Twenty One Pilots?
easy.fact: Tyler Joseph and Josh Dun have been the lineup since 2011.

medium.q: In what year did Mean Girls hit theaters?
medium.fact: Tina Fey wrote the script and played math teacher Ms. Norbury.

medium.q: How many players are on an MLB team's active roster for most of the season?
How many main islands make up the state of Hawaii?
medium.fact: Only seven are inhabited; Kahoolawe has no permanent residents.

medium.q: How many U.S. presidents have died in office?
medium.fact: Four died of natural causes and four were assassinated.

medium.q: How many seasons of How I Met Your Mother were made?
medium.fact: The show ran on CBS from 2005 to 2014.

hard.q: How tall is Toronto's CN Tower, to the nearest foot?
hard.fact: It was the world's tallest freestanding structure for over 30 years.

hard.q: Amelia Earhart's 1932 solo flight across the Atlantic took how many hours, to the nearest hour?
hard.fact: She landed in a pasture in Northern Ireland.

hard.q: The Chicago Cubs' 2016 World Series title ended a drought of how many years?
How many episodes of Lost aired over its six seasons?
hard.fact: Its pilot was one of the most expensive ever made at the time.
